newsitem.title: ALBANIA: More Albanians die in weekend of violence.
newsitem.headline: More Albanians die in weekend of violence.

text.p: Sporadic violence claimed four more lives in Albania on Sunday, increasing the death toll of what has been a bloody weekend in the chaotic Balkan state to 10.
The killings are new examples of the lawlessness which has claimed several hundred lives since rioting erupted in March, sparked by the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
Estimates say up to a million weapons were looted from military arsenals, adding a deadly edge to the chaos.
In the southern port town of Vlore, the epicentre of the unrest, an unidentified man was murdered on Sunday in what local police called an execution.
Near Vlore, one man was killed after trying to stop his car being stolen while two men were killed at the railway station after gunmen raked their car with bullets.
A police officer was killed by gunmen on Saturday night in the southern town of Kucove, the state-run news agency ATA said.
A 13-year-old in a bar in the southern town of Berat and a man in a van in the northern town of Kukes were shot as youths drove past them and opened fire randomly.
Another man was killed by a stray bullet, also near Kukes.
The killings followed those of two people in Vlore in a gun battle on Saturday.
